The '''Viper grenade launcher''' was a weapon attachment that could be mounted onto the underside of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbines]] such as the [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]].

==Description==
The Viper was considered one of the best gun-mounted grenade launchers of its time, thanks to its [[Tybrene]] launcher and built-in vibro balancing systems, and was extremely accurate at short ranges. The only major drawback to the system was that its magazine had storage for just two [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. The firing stud to launch a grenade was on the right side of the launcher, just in front of the magazine.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>

[[Vandro]], a member of [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]], used a Viper grenade launcher during the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]].<ref name="TSB">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>
